title: Solomon's Wealth and Power
description: Description of King Solomon's immense wealth: 666 talents of gold annually, two hundred large and three hundred small shields of beaten gold, a magnificent throne of ivory overlaid with pure gold with lions on the steps, four thousand stalls for horses and twelve thousand horsemen, as well as merchant ships that every third year sailed to Tarshish bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks. Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom, and silver was as common as stones in Jerusalem.
